correctness.rationale: The four exact binary observation cell probabilities imply the nuisance-adjusted Fisher information at true q=1/2. For x=gamma Delta the derivative has sign opposite g_p(x); g_p(x)<0 for x<=log2 and g_p is strictly increasing thereafter, with one zero. Thus global uniqueness is analytical. Its parameter derivative gives strictly decreasing optimum x*(p), and substituting x=1 gives the sharp crossing p_c. The exact-rational checker reconstructs cell scores and their Schur complement at 460 parameter pairs and verifies 2300 arithmetic assertions; 863 numeric checks confirm constants and root signs. Neither finite testing nor a log substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: The model combines two central ecological survey limitations, imperfect detections and genuinely changing occupancy. Treating occupancy as an estimated nuisance reveals a strict shift of Fisher-optimal revisit interval with detectability, from 0.796812 at p=1 to 1.138091 in the small-p limit, with the exact p_c=0.699848 threshold dividing sub- versus super-switching-time designs. The exact classification and threshold are natural, interpretable design benchmarks and show why the perfect-detection rule fails for lower detectability. Their practical interpretation is limited to idealized, calibrated local asymptotic design with many independent sites.
